recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: deno taking root on the desktop
sakana fugu drifting through developer feeds
karl the fog holding san francisco at thirteen celsius
summer solstice week still wrapped in coastal mist
stutter house pulses beneath melodic techno skies
distant capitals exchanging first quiet words

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Steer a firefly through rolling fog banks, collecting melodic fragments that layer into a stutter-house loop before the mist swallows the light.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: drag to weave through fog wisps
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each fragment adds a beat layer — hear a full 30-second track assemble in one run
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog thickens, gaps narrow, beat intervals shrink
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe glimmers through grey watercolor mist

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap-release on rising waveform peaks to stitch an underground house set — miss a beat and the room's energy flatlines before the drop.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: tap on beat, hold for sustained notes
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: land a perfect 8-bar loop to trigger the drop and clear the round
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: BPM climbs, ghost notes appear, crowd meter drains on misses
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: underground club VHS grain with amber vu meters

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Flick a paper origami fugu across a koi pond, bouncing off lily pads toward a shrine before the fish inflates and sinks.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.touch_control: one-thumb flick to launch and ricochet
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: three clean bounces trigger a serene splash finale
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: lily pads shrink, ripples push back, inflation risk rises each bounce
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: paper cutout ukiyo-e with ink-wash water

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Draw branching agent paths on a terminal screen so desktop processes spawn and execute before the compile window closes.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: drag to connect nodes into runnable pipelines
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: complete one working pipeline in under 45 seconds
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: nodes multiply, timer shrinks, broken links cascade errors
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: phosphor green on matte black terminal glass
